html_source: 1712 woodcut illustration of the parable of the talents from the Historiae celebriores Veteris Testamenti Iconibus representatae, showing the two good servants returning money to their master and the third looking for his in the ground where he buried it. Source: Wikimedia Commons.

1712 woodcut illustration of the parable of the
